jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Product Infrastructure
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Company

Valon is the leading AI platform for mortgage servicing, building the AI-native operating system for regulated finance.

Before providing the system of record that powers the entire industry, we built and ran our own mortgage servicer on it. That gave us a real regulated environment to prove our technology could replace the mainframe systems servicers have used for decades. Carrington acquired that servicer and adopted ValonOS as its core platform, allowing us to focus entirely on scaling our SaaS platform.

ValonOS is now on track to power 1 in 6 U.S. mortgages across major mortgage servicers like Newrez, Carrington, and ServiceMac. Every process on the platform is structured and programmable, enabling our AI agents to perform core servicing work, like handling payments, escrow, and homeowner questions, directly within the system's controls.

We recently raised a $150 million Series D at a $2.3 billion valuation joined by new investor Ribbit Capital, with continued support from existing backer a16z, amongst others.

About the Team

You’ll join the core Platform & Infrastructure product org. This team builds the foundational systems and services that serve as the backbone for features across our entire product suite.

While many infrastructure teams operate behind the scenes, ours sits at an intersection. We build systems that internal vertical teams depend on, and we also deliver features that directly touch end users (e.g. platforms, self-service tools, dashboards). Because of that, you’ll balance deep technical rigor with customer empathy.

We operate in a high-growth, high-authenticity engineering culture. You’ll partner with senior engineers, architects, and cross-functional leads, and have high visibility across the org.

Responsibilities

As a Senior Product Manager, Infrastructure & Platform, you will:

  • Define and own the roadmap for one or more core infrastructure domains (such as notification platform, documents platform, user management, etc.)

  • Deeply engage with internal stakeholders (engineering leads, vertical PMs, operations) and our customers to drive discovery and specification

  • Drive initiatives end-to-end: from ideation, discovery, scoping, to launch, adoption, and iteration

  • Work directly with customers/stakeholders (sometimes on-site at their operations) so that your deliverables are finely tuned to their unique and complex processes

  • Ensure infrastructure is resilient, scalable, observable, and secure — balancing performance, reliability, and long-term extensibility

  • Lead discovery for complex customer processes: conduct customer interviews and complete process mapping across multiple customers of varying profiles

  • Deep ability to map processes and systems even in high ambiguity — e.g. you can take a domain with many moving pieces and build a reliable abstraction

  • Write clear, structured product specs, user stories that are easy to understand, even for someone without any domain knowledge

  • Partner closely with engineering leadership and architects to make tradeoffs on design, performance, scale, and technical debt

  • Evangelize infrastructure best practices across the organization and influence roadmap tradeoffs

Ideal Background

  • 5+ years of product management (or equivalent) experience, ideally with exposure to b2b saas products, product infrastructure, and platforms

  • Strong technical fluency: experience working with engineers around systems, APIs, data models, etc.

  • Excellent customer discovery skills: comfortable conducting interviews, writing journey maps, and synthesizing qualitative + quantitative inputs

  • Track record of shipping infrastructure or platform features that were adopted broadly or had measurable impact

  • Highly structured thinker, able to write and communicate complex concepts simply

  • Comfortable operating with high autonomy, ambiguity, and responsibility

  • Strong collaboration skills: able to manage stakeholders, drive alignment, and hold cross-team accountability

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, Business Administration, Finance, Economics, or a closely related field

Why Join Valon?

  • Transform a $13 trillion industry by building the operating system for mortgage servicing, replacing 40-year-old legacy systems with modern, AI-powered infrastructure

  • Join at a pivotal moment: We're rapidly scaling, with contracts signed or in negotiation representing nearly 30% of the entire mortgage servicing market

  • Work on complex, high-impact problems with massive scale, our platform will power servicing operations for millions of homeowners across the country

  • Product and Engineering-led culture with exceptional talent density, work alongside world-class engineers and product leaders who value velocity, clarity, and deep technical excellence

  • Real product ownership with enterprise impact: your decisions will directly influence how major financial institutions operate and serve their customers

  • Unique market position: We're winning against entrenched incumbents by delivering 75%+ cost reduction and a modern software experience that were previously not possible

Benefits

  • Compensation: competitive salary with a meaningful stake in the company via equity, and 401(k) plan. The base salary range reflects multiple levels. We assess level based on a combination of experience and interview performance.

  • Health & well-being: we’ll invest in your physical and mental well-being with comprehensive medical, dental, & vision benefits.

  • Free Food: daily lunch, and dinner provided through Forkable for in-office team members.

  • Commuter benefits: pre-tax deductions for public transit, rideshares, and parking to simplify your daily commute.

  • Grow together: company wide orientation for you to successfully onboard and other learning & development opportunities including regular review cycles that feature 360-degree feedback.

  • Play together: quarterly budgets for team and company outings. Use it for team swag, cooking classes, or team dinners.

  • Generous time off: flexible paid time off with no annual limit, sick days, and 11 company holidays.

  • Baby bonding time: 12 weeks of fully paid leave for both birthing and non-birthing parents, so you can spend uninterrupted time welcoming and caring for your newest family member.

Throughout the interview process, please remember that emails will only be from valon.com email addresses. We will never ask for any personally identifiable information during the interview process itself. Please reach out to talent@valon.com if you have any requests to verify the authenticity of an outreach.

Valon is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. Valon makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

jobs.title: Senior Platform Product Manager, FinOps
jobs.descriptionHtml:
As a Senior Platform Product Manager for FinOps, you will drive the vision, roadmap, and product outcomes for how Datadog understands and acts on its infrastructure costs. Your customers are Datadog's engineers, Finance team and product managers. You will make complex cost data useful in their daily decisions: what changed, why it changed, what happens next, and what to do about it. You will enable intuitive cost allocation, explanation, and forecasting experiences, and connect internal needs with Datadog's Cloud Cost Management product.


At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.


What You’ll Do:

  • Own discovery, strategy, and prioritization for internal FinOps products. Understand the distinct decisions Engineering, Finance, executives, and PMs need to make, and validate which problems are most valuable to solve.
  • Make cost allocation understandable and actionable, including shared-platform costs, service consumption, and product and customer margins. Embed cost views into the core platforms, dashboards, and workflows teams already use.
  • Improve the cost-explanation experience so teams can quickly understand cost changes, identify their causes, distinguish ongoing costs from temporary changes, and project timelines for expected cost corrections. Where current processes depend on a mandate, build the product that teams will choose to use, then retire the mandate. 
  • Make the underlying metrics self-serve so teams track their own costs, and reduce the review to the decisions that need a room.
  • Partner with engineering on timely detection, insights, monitors, and alerts, and support the Engineering-ownership program that puts cost explanation on Engineering leaders.
  • Shape forecasting tools with Finance and FinOps around shared data, visible assumptions, and traceable scenarios. Help teams use cost data for capacity, efficiency, and resource-planning decisions.
  • Bridge FinOps and CCM product roadmaps by 1) running joint roadmap reviews with the CCM product team to identify overlapping builds before work starts, and 2) deciding what to reuse, where internal needs justify new capabilities, and which validated internal solutions could benefit external customers.
  • Lead pilots with representative users, test usability, and use feedback and adoption evidence to guide broader rollouts. 
  • Define baselines and success measures for adoption, time to explain cost changes, manual effort, allocation coverage and trust, and adoption of forecast tooling, with assumptions traceable to source. Use these measures to prioritize work and show how the product improves decisions.

Who You Are:

  • You have prior product management experience owning discovery, prioritization, and shipped outcomes, plus substantial hands-on FinOps or cloud cost-management experience. 
  • You understand cost allocation, shared infrastructure economics, forecasting, and the different questions engineering and finance teams ask of the same cost data. You can reason about efficiency, usage growth, and product or customer margins.
  • You can turn complex data and technical systems into clear product experiences. You've worked directly with users, tested your assumptions, and improved adoption or reduced effort through what you shipped.
  • You bring strong analytical and systems thinking. You can interrogate cost and usage data, challenge assumptions, evaluate trade-offs, and define measures that help teams decide what to do next. 
  • You communicate clearly with engineers, analysts, Finance, and executives, adapting the level of detail to the decision. You earn trust across teams and form evidence-backed recommendations when priorities conflict.
  • You're curious about how AI is changing infrastructure economics and product work. You continuously evaluate and use the latest tools to learn and test ideas quickly, and apply judgment to data quality, attribution, and the reliability of automated outputs.


Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

Benefits & Growth:

  • New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)
  • Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing
  • Intra-departmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking
  • An inclusive company culture, ability to join our Community Guilds
  • Access to Inclusion Talks, our Internal panel discussions

locations: NYC, SSF, SEA, Chicago, Toronto, US-Remote
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Millions of businesses across the internet run on Stripe. The Stripe Business Network team is building the B2B network that turns that scale into value for every one of them: a place where businesses discover and transact with each other, share verified data, and move money instantly and seamlessly.

We're building the experiences that make that network real. A single view of your entire Stripe network, including every platform, partner, and customer you do business with, where a new relationship is just a click away. Portable identity, so when you start working with a new platform, your verified business information comes with you instead of being collected from scratch. Closed-loop money movement, so paying another Stripe business is instant and costs a fraction of a card payment. A business directory where the right counterparties can find you. And trusted data sharing and profile representation, so counterparties have confidence in who they're working with.

Every business that joins makes the network more valuable for everyone already on it. We think of the Business Network as the business graph for the internet economy, and we're building for what's next.

What you'll do

You will build the Stripe Business Network experiences, including the Network Tab (a single page to see your whole Stripe network), search and discovery, profiles, networked invoicing, and much more, to deliver utility to our users across the board.

That means being a true champion of our users: end-to-end owner of core flows, a cross-functional partner to Engineering, Design, and GTM, and an active voice in shaping the Business Network's strategy alongside leadership. You'll define, build, and scale new and existing products, informed by user insights and data.

We're looking for a technical PM who operates with a high degree of autonomy and drive. You care deeply about craft and impact. The only thing that really matters to you is getting well-built products into users' hands. You're already exploring how AI is changing how products get built and what it means for the PM role; you might even have a few half-finished side projects that prove it.

Responsibilities

  • Own the user's perspective. Spend time with users, and synthesize their feedback and market signals into clear product direction.
  • Obsess over user impact rather than features shipped. Always ask (and quantify) how each release delivers value and utility to our users.
  • Drive high-velocity, high-craft execution and own outcomes. Lead cross-functional work from discovery through launch, and hold yourself accountable for adoption, user value, and business impact.
  • Own Stripe's strategic priorities. Use judgment to factor in Stripe's strategic positioning and leverage, and make network-accretive product choices.
  • Partner deeply with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Marketing, Sales, and Operations to ship cohesive, frictionless experiences.

Who you are

We're looking for a high-agency, high-paced product manager with strong craft to bring the next set of network features to life.

Minimum requirements

  • 7+ years in a product or technical role, with experience shipping world-class products at scale
  • High agency and an ownership mindset. You do whatever it takes to solve problems, delight users, and deliver business impact. You climb walls to get there.
  • High resilience and resourcefulness. You see around corners, think ahead, and find a way where there seemingly isn't one. You are highly proactive and able to set the pace for a team
  • High taste, design empathy, and sharp judgment. You put yourself in the shoes of users and are a steward of great experiences that deliver real utility.
  • Rigorous with data, including digging into metrics, getting to insight, telling a story with data, and thinking from first principles to deliver the right results
  • Strong written and verbal communication, with a talent for distilling user problems into precise, actionable framing
  • Thrive with a high level of autonomy and responsibility

 

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with complex payments or financial products, or building networks and marketplaces
  • Experience building brand-new products or working in a startup environment
  • Experience working with GTM teams to bring new products to market

jobs.title: Senior Data Product Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
THE POSITION 

Our roster has an opening with your name on it 

FanDuel is looking for a Senior Product Manager to own Core Data Infrastructure (CDI) within our centralized Data Products team. CDI is the foundational layer that powers every data product at FanDuel: our Databricks lakehouse platform, workflow orchestration, self-service data tooling, and the governance and cost discipline that keep all of it trustworthy and efficient. You will set product direction across four engineering verticals (Data Tooling, Databricks Platform, Data Platform Customer Success, and Data Security), working daily with senior engineering leadership to move CDI from an engineering-led backlog to a product-led roadmap with clear priorities, defensible metrics, and measurable adoption. This is a high-visibility, high-ownership role on the critical path for company-wide data reliability, compliance (SOX, ABAC and data governance), and platform cost management, feeding directly into FanDuel's broader Data Platform strategy and 2026 OKRs. 

In addition to the specific responsibilities outlined above, employees may be required to perform other such duties as assigned by the Company. This ensures operational flexibility and allows the Company to meet evolving business needs. 

 

THE GAME PLAN 
Everyone on our team has a part to play 

  • Own the CDI product roadmap end to end: the Databricks lakehouse platform, Airflow orchestration, and Stargate (our self-service data access and provisioning tool), translating a large technical backlog into a focused, prioritized roadmap. 
  • Partner day-to-day with engineering leadership across CDI's four verticals (Data Tooling, Databricks Platform, Data Platform Customer Success, Data Security) to move planning from engineering-led to product-led, using clear decision ownership (DACI) and defensible, dashboard-backed metrics. 
  • Drive platform cost governance and FinOps discipline; own tooling such as the internal Cost Estimator and advance cost estimates toward a required gate before new infrastructure is provisioned. 
  • Own data governance, security, and compliance commitments tied to the platform, including SOX controls, attribute-based access control (ABAC), and Unity Catalog governance, partnering with Data Security and Legal/Compliance to keep the platform audit-ready. 
  • Lead the self-service vision for Stargate and internal data tooling (Orbit, Nexus): grow adoption, define success metrics, and reduce the reactive support-ticket load that consumes a large share of the team's capacity. 
  • Represent CDI in FanDuel's Unified Data Context and semantic layer strategy, partnering with peer Data Product Managers and Central AI to define scope, sequencing, and hand-offs as the program matures. 
  • Elicit requirements in the form of clear problem statements, user stories, and acceptance criteria, and run a disciplined backlog that engineering managers and stakeholders can plan against with confidence. 
  • Monitor platform health (reliability, data quality, blocked-work trends, and adoption) and use that signal to continuously re-prioritize the roadmap. 
  • Play an active role in FanDuel's Product Management community, sharing best practices and helping raise the bar for product-led thinking across traditionally engineering-led teams. 

  

THE STATS 

What we’re looking for in our next teammate  

  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager or Product Owner shipping infrastructure, platform, or developer-tooling products, ideally within a data or ML platform organization, with a proven track record of turning a large technical backlog into a focused, prioritized roadmap. 
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline) or equivalent industry experience preferred; a Master's degree is a plus. 
  • Direct experience with modern lakehouse and orchestration technology such as Databricks, Apache Airflow (or equivalent), and cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), sufficient to earn credibility with senior platform engineers and make sound trade-off calls. 
  • Working knowledge of data governance and access-control models (Unity Catalog, ABAC, or comparable attribute/role-based access frameworks), and comfort operating in a regulated, compliance-sensitive environment (SOX, audit controls). 
  • Experience owning cost or FinOps workstreams for a data or cloud platform: building the case for cost governance and driving adoption of cost-estimation or chargeback tooling. 
  • A product-led operating style: comfortable pushing back on engineering-led planning, applying frameworks like DACI for decision clarity, and holding a hard line on a small number of priorities rather than a long tail of parallel work. 
  • Strong stakeholder management across a wide, technical partner group: comfortable running requirements workshops, negotiating scope with engineering managers, and communicating platform trade-offs to non-technical leadership. 
  • SQL proficiency for querying platform usage and cost data; familiarity with semantic layer, metrics-registry, or data-catalog concepts is a strong plus. 
  • Knowledge of sports and/or experience working within a heavily regulated industry is a plus. 
  • Don't check all the boxes? That's okay! We encourage you to still apply if you feel like you possess an adjacent skill set and are interested in learning more about this position. 

ABOUT FANDUEL 

FanDuel Group is the premier mobile gaming company in the United States and Canada. FanDuel Group consists of a portfolio of leading brands across mobile wagering including: America’s #1 Sportsbook, FanDuel Sportsbook; its leading iGaming platform, FanDuel Casino; the industry’s unquestioned leader in horse racing and advance-deposit wagering, FanDuel Racing; and its daily fantasy sports product.   

In addition, FanDuel Group operates FanDuel TV, its broadly distributed linear cable television network and FanDuel TV+, its leading direct-to-consumer OTT platform. FanDuel Group has a presence across all 50 states, Canada, and Puerto Rico.  

The company is based in New York with US offices in Los Angeles, Atlanta, and Jersey City, as well as global offices in Canada and Scotland. The company’s affiliates have offices worldwide, including in Ireland, Portugal, Romania, and Australia. 

FanDuel Group is a subsidiary of Flutter Entertainment, the world's largest sports betting and gaming operator with a portfolio of globally recognized brands and traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: FLUT). 

 

PLAYER BENEFITS

We offer amazing benefits above and beyond the basics. We have an array of health plans to choose from (some as low as $0 per paycheck) that include programs for fertility and family planning, mental health support, and fitness benefits. We offer generous paid time off (PTO & sick leave), annual bonus and long-term incentive opportunities (based on performance), 401k with up to a 5% match, commuter benefits, pet insurance, and more - check out all our benefits here: FanDuel Total Rewards. *Benefits differ across location, role, and level.

FanDuel is looking for a Data Product Manager to join our centralized Data Products team and own the products and services behind how FanDuel personalizes and experiments. Your flagship product is Personalization, one of FanDuel’s largest strategic programs, and it is just getting started. 

The vision has two parts. The first is one personalization service that works with any front end. Given a customer, a page, and a moment, it returns ranked content that any surface can render, across sports betting, casino, racing, predictions, fantasy, social and community, payments, editorial, and video. Redesign the app tomorrow and the service does not change. The second is a personalization flywheel. It is a closed loop where ideas are generated, pre-tested, run as live experiments, and analyzed, and each result feeds the next round. Today most good ideas never get tested because experiment capacity is scarce and analysis is slow. You will own the products that change that. 

Working closely with the Director of Data Product, you will drive requirements, prioritization, and delivery across customer understanding, ranking, serving, and experimentation. You will partner daily with data science, ML Platform, ML engineering, product analytics, and product managers in every business unit to turn a fast-moving, cross-functional program into shipped, measurable results. This is a high-visibility role tied directly to our “One App, One Customer” data strategy, our 2027 OKRs, and customer engagement, retention, and revenue. 

In addition to the specific responsibilities outlined above, employees may be required to perform other such duties as assigned by the Company. This ensures operational flexibility and allows the Company to meet evolving business needs. 

 

THE GAME PLAN 


Everyone on our team has a part to play 

  • Own the backlog and delivery for one personalization product area, such as experimentation tooling or ranking inputs, and deliver it in small, shippable releases. 
  • Work with the Director of Data Product and senior PMs to shape the personalization roadmap, recommending priorities and trade-offs based on customer data and experiment results. 
  • Translate broader program goals into clear problem statements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineering and data science can plan against. 
  • Partner with data science and ML engineering on recommendation and ranking approaches, asking questions about accuracy, latency, and cost, and turning their input into product requirements. 
  • Work with product analytics and the experimentation platform team to define hypotheses, success and guardrail metrics, and test readouts for your area, and share what you learn with the team. 
  • Support responsible gaming, privacy, and compliance requirements in your area by working with Legal, Compliance, and Responsible Gaming, and escalate open questions early. 
  • Give status updates to your pod and key stakeholders, flagging risks and blockers early so issues are resolved before they affect delivery. 
  • Escalate cross-team conflicts and decisions outside your remit to the Director, and bring a recommendation with each escalation. 
  • Seek and act on feedback from your manager, peers, and partners, and share knowledge with other PMs in the Product Management community. 
  • Contribute to other Data Product initiatives as priorities evolve, keeping focus on a small number of priorities rather than parallel work. 

  

THE STATS 

What we’re looking for in our next teammate  

  • 3+ years of experience as a Product Manager or Product Owner on personalization, recommendation, search, ranking, experimentation, or other data or ML-powered products, with a record of shipping and measuring results. 
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Business, or related) or equivalent industry experience. A Master’s degree is a plus. 
  • Working knowledge of how recommender and ranking systems work (collaborative filtering, learning-to-rank, embeddings, or similar), enough to engage credibly with data scientists and ML engineers on accuracy, latency, and cost. 
  • Exposure to personalization across varied content types (commerce, media, gaming, social feeds, payments), including cold-start and cross-sell, is a strong plus. 
  • Hands-on experimentation experience. You have designed and run A/B tests, chosen primary and guardrail metrics, and read results carefully. You know common traps such as peeking, underpowered tests, and novelty effects. 
  • Hands-on use of AI tools in your product and experimentation work, such as using LLMs to draft hypotheses, design tests, or speed up analysis. 
  • Working understanding of how LLM-based agents are built and evaluated (tools, prompts, guardrails, and evals). Experience taking an agent into production is a plus. 
  • Product-led mindset: comfortable questioning engineering-led plans, using frameworks like DACI for decision clarity, and focusing on a small number of priorities. 
  • Clear communicator who writes crisp requirements, explains trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences, and is comfortable sizing opportunities in dollar terms. 
  • SQL proficiency for exploring customer behavior, experiment results, and model performance data. 
  • Knowledge of sports, gaming, or entertainment, and/or experience in a heavily regulated industry with privacy and responsible-use constraints, is a plus. Familiarity with Databricks, Kafka, Amplitude, Snowplow, or Xtremepush is also a plus. 
  • Don’t check all the boxes? That’s okay! We encourage you to still apply if you feel like you possess an adjacent skill set and are interested in learning more about this position. 

 

ABOUT FANDUEL
FanDuel Group is the premier mobile gaming company in the United States and Canada. FanDuel Group consists of a portfolio of leading brands across mobile wagering including: America’s #1 Sportsbook, FanDuel Sportsbook; its leading iGaming platform, FanDuel Casino; the industry’s unquestioned leader in horse racing and advance-deposit wagering, FanDuel Racing; and its daily fantasy sports product.
In addition, FanDuel Group operates FanDuel TV, its broadly distributed linear cable television network and FanDuel TV+, its leading direct-to-consumer OTT platform. FanDuel Group has a presence across all 50 states, Canada, and Puerto Rico.
The company is based in New York with US offices in Los Angeles, Atlanta, and Jersey City, as well as global offices in Canada and Scotland. The company’s affiliates have offices worldwide, including in Ireland, Portugal, Romania, and Australia.
FanDuel Group is a subsidiary of Flutter Entertainment, the world's largest sports betting and gaming operator with a portfolio of globally recognized brands and traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: FLUT).

We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. Product at Brex

We align cross-functional teams—including Engineering, Legal, Compliance, and Design—on key decisions, set strategy, and drive products from inception to launch.

What you’ll do

Processing a single expense is becoming commoditized. Managing expenses across an enterprise is not. Companies must distribute cards broadly while controlling risk, documenting transactions, enforcing policy, routing approvals, preparing for audit, and producing ERP-ready records.

As Senior Product Manager for Expenses, you will turn that complexity into one intelligent system for employees, managers, finance teams, and accountants. You will lead the strategy across documentation, policy, compliance, approvals, substantiation, audit, and accounting readiness.

You will align specialized product teams across Engineering, Design, Risk, Compliance, Accounting, and GTM. Using AI and automation, you will eliminate routine work, surface meaningful exceptions, help finance teams close faster, and build capabilities that win major enterprise relationships.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in either our San Francisco, Seattle, or New York office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end strategy for enterprise expense management.
  • Unify documentation, policy, compliance, approvals, substantiation, audit, and ERP readiness.
  • Define the systems, data models, configurations, and controls complex enterprises require.
  • Align specialized product teams around the complete expense lifecycle.
  • Use AI to automate routine work and route only judgment-heavy exceptions to people.
  • Partner with Design to make sophisticated enterprise workflows intuitive.
  • Align Engineering, Design, Risk, Compliance, Accounting, Sales, and Customer Success around enterprise outcomes.

Requirements

  • A track record of leading complex enterprise workflow or systems products.
  • Strong technical fluency in backend systems, data models, integrations, and configurable product architecture.
  • Experience supporting extensive customer permutations without sacrificing usability.
  • Ability to unite multiple domains under one strategy and operating model.
  • Strong customer and Design judgment across employee, manager, finance, and accounting experiences.
  • Concrete judgment about where AI should remove work and where human review matters.
  • Strong cross-functional influence and an understanding of how product capabilities affect enterprise sales and adoption.

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $184,000 - $230,000.  However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

About Us

Rho is the modern banking platform built for the AI era. Startups and growth-stage companies can open accounts in minutes, issue cards, manage expenses, pay bills, and close the books – all in one connected platform backed by real human support.

The Role

The best products grow because people can't stop using them and can't help telling others about them.

We want Rho to grow because of the product. Every founder who uses Rho pays vendors, issues cards to their team, and invites people in. Every one of those moments is someone meeting Rho for the first time, and a chance to bring in the next customer. Your job is to make the most of every one.

We're hiring a Growth PM to own how Rho grows through the product itself, from the first time someone hears about us to the moment Rho becomes their bank. That means three things:

  1. Get founders into the funnel. Grow the top of the funnel through referrals, network effects and every place Rho already touches.

  2. Get them through sign up. Work closely with your partners across product to make getting approved fast and painless.

  3. Get them fully onboarded. Make sure they actually switch banks and start using everything Rho can do, not just open an account.

What you'd own

  • The growth strategy, not just the features. Define the bets, the channels and the metrics that drive our next stage of growth, and be accountable for the number.

  • A referral engine founders love to use. Make referring Rho effortless and a little bit fun, then keep making it better.

  • Network effects across every edge. Vendors who get paid, employees who get cards, payees, and accountants all touch Rho. Turn each of those into a reason to sign up.

  • The top of the funnel, in partnership with marketing. Work hand in hand with our marketing team on acquisition, conversion and where we invest.

  • Activation, all the way through. Get founders past sign up and into the product. Get them to switch banks, issue cards, pay their first bill, and run their business all on Rho.

  • Unconventional bets. Some of the best growth ideas won't look like product work. Bring them anyway.

Who you are

You've done this before: at least 5 years in product, with real growth or product led acquisition work you can point to and a number you moved.

You are the kind of person who:

  • Thinks in loops, not funnels. You see how one customer brings in the next and design for that.

  • Has strong product judgment and taste. Growth tactics that cheapen the product aren't wins. You find the ones that make it better.

  • Lives in the data. You size the opportunity, set the metric, run the experiment and know whether it worked.

  • Moves fast. You ship something real, learn from it, and ship again.

  • Uses AI to do more with less. Not just for your own work, but to build systems that let a small team grow a big business.

  • Partners well. Marketing, design, engineering, sales, post sales and support all touch growth. You bring them along.

Who this isn't for

  • Marketers who want to stay in marketing. This is a product role. You'll be building, not running campaigns.

  • Feature PMs looking for a change of scenery. Growth is its own craft. We need someone who already loves it.

  • Anyone who needs a fully formed roadmap handed to them. You'll write it.

The bar

We're building the best business banking platform in the world for founders. If you're already thinking about how you'd get every vendor we pay to become a customer, we should talk.

Our people are our most valuable asset. Our target compensation range for this role is $165,000 - $320,000. Compensation will be determined by leveling and performance throughout the interview process. In addition to base pay, Rho offers equity, comprehensive healthcare benefits, and paid time off.

About Mixpanel

Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com.

About the Team

The mission of the AI Engine team is to ground Mixpanel in AI-native foundations, enabling internal teams to deploy capabilities with accelerating speed while providing customers with intelligent, highly context-aware product insights.. The team owns the full MCP stack (server, client, and dynamic client registration), the context engine, Mixpanel's AI quality and evals framework, prompt infrastructure, and AI compliance.

AI Engine serves three customers at once. 

  • Product builders — the PMs, engineers, and analysts at companies using Mixpanel — experience the platform indirectly, through whether Mixpanel AI gives them trustworthy answers. 
  • Every internal Mixpanel team shipping an AI feature is a direct customer: when the platform is there, they build with speed and confidence instead of rebuilding foundations from scratch. 
  • And increasingly, the “user” isn't human at all — it's an agent that depends on the team's context engine, MCP coverage, and quality guarantees to act on a person's behalf.

The team is also its own best customer: every AI feature inside Mixpanel runs on the same substrate shipped to the rest of the company, so the foundation gets tested by Mixpanel's own product teams before anyone else touches it.

About the Role

As Senior Product Manager for AI Engine, you'll own the roadmap for the infrastructure every AI surface at Mixpanel is built on — from MCP and the context engine to the evals framework that defines what “good” means for an AI agent. Your stakeholders are mostly other builders: engineers, PMs on other teams, and increasingly the agents themselves. Your product's success shows up in what it lets other teams ship, not in a single customer-facing feature.

You'll work closely with engineering and design to take the team from MCP parity today toward trusted, autonomous agents — establishing quality baselines, driving adoption of shared infrastructure across the rest of Mixpanel's product org, and making the case, in writing, for where the platform should invest next.

What You'll Do

  • Set and evolve the strategy for Mixpanel's AI platform — using adoption data from internal teams, agent usage patterns, and customer signal to decide where the platform should invest next
  • Align engineering and design on the highest-leverage substrate work — MCP parity, the context engine, the evals framework, prompt infrastructure — with clear, written plans that hold up under scrutiny
  • Work closely with engineering to experiment with and ship new platform capabilities, from MCP tooling to model routing to context memory, without sacrificing the reliability every downstream team depends on
  • Define what “quality” means for an AI agent and build the evals, baselines, and dashboards that make it measurable — then track whether what shipped actually moved it
  • Drive adoption of shared infrastructure across other product teams — decide the right model (opt-in, mandated standard, or incentive-based) and own the motion that gets teams to build on the platform instead of rebuilding it themselves
  • Tell a clear story about platform investments — to engineering leadership, to other PM teams, and eventually to customers — that connects infrastructure work to the business outcomes it unlocks
  • Prioritize ruthlessly across a long list of platform bets, balancing unblocking internal teams today against the long-term bet on an external, customer-facing intelligence layer
  • Help define the AI compliance and trust standards every team shipping an AI feature at Mixpanel has to meet

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of hands-on product management experience, including time as a platform, infrastructure, or developer-tools PM
  • Comfort being the PM for engineers and other internal teams rather than only end customers — you're energized by a product whose success is measured in what it lets other people build
  • An ability to synthesize usage data, agent behavior, and qualitative feedback from internal stakeholders to drive clarity on what the platform should do next
  • A track record of developing, articulating, and executing a product strategy that other teams had to align behind, not just your own
  • Experience using AI tools in product management workflows (e.g., competitive research, prototyping)
  • Direct experience working with LLMs, agents, or AI quality/evals — you understand why performing well on a handful of examples isn't the same as being reliable in production

Bonus Points For

  • Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol), agent frameworks, or building on top of LLM APIs
  • Experience as a PM for a developer platform, API product, or internal infrastructure team
  • Experience using Mixpanel as an end customer
  • Experience writing production-grade software
  • Experience designing products using tools like Figma, Sketch, or Abstract

Variable compensation type is determined by your role and level. In addition to the cash compensation provided, this position is also eligible for equity consideration and other benefits including medical, vision, and dental insurance coverage. Within the range, individual pay is determined by experience, job-related skills, qualifications, and other factors. From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

 

About the Role

Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.

Every production dbt pipeline depends on orchestration. When a job runs late, fails without anyone noticing, or gets stuck in a queue, the people downstream stop trusting the data. As Senior Product Manager for Orchestration, you will own how dbt runs in production: how jobs are scheduled and triggered, how they recover when something goes wrong, and how teams find out and fix it.

You will own the vision, roadmap, and outcomes for orchestration on the dbt platform. That covers the job scheduler, triggers and job chaining, retries and run reliability, concurrency and queueing, jobs as code, run monitoring, and notifications. Data teams of every size depend on these systems every day, from a single nightly job to enterprise deployments with hundreds of interdependent jobs across many projects.

You will work closely with the engineering teams behind the scheduler and the v2 engine, with the dbt State team, and with Fivetran’s platform teams as data movement and transformation come together. You will also help define what orchestration looks like as AI agents begin to trigger, monitor, and fix pipelines alongside people. We are looking for someone who is technical, close to customers, and excited by reliability problems: a PM who wants to make the dbt Platform the best place to run dbt in production.

This is a full-time position based out of our Denver office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration, including two days in the office each week to connect and build as a team.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Own the orchestration strategy and roadmap

    • Define and own the vision and roadmap for dbt platform orchestration, including scheduling, event- and API-based triggers, chaining across jobs and projects, retries, concurrency and queueing, and jobs as code. Turn that vision into clear priorities, sequencing, and tradeoffs.

    • Set success metrics for run reliability, on-time delivery, and time to recovery, and hold yourself accountable for moving them.

    • Decide where to invest, what to build, and what not to build, using customer evidence, usage data, and technical judgment.

  • Make production dbt reliable and observable

    • Partner with engineering to improve run reliability: fewer failed or stuck runs, clearer classification of what went wrong, and faster recovery when it does.

    • Own notifications and run monitoring across email, Slack, webhooks, and integrations, so teams hear about failures quickly, understand what broke, and know what to do next.

    • Work with the v2 and dbt State teams to make sure jobs build only what they need to, and stay fast and cost-efficient at scale.

  • Drive cross-functional execution

    • Lead engineering and design through a predictable shipping cadence, with crisp feature briefs and PRDs that keep teams aligned on what matters and why.

    • Partner with Fivetran platform teams on a connected experience for scheduling and running pipelines across data movement and transformation.

    • Equip Product Marketing, Sales, Solutions Architects, and Support with clear positioning, launch materials, and guidance, including how dbt orchestration compares to standalone orchestrators.

  • Stay close to users and the market

    • Build tight feedback loops with customers who run dbt in production, from small analytics teams to large enterprises, and with teams that orchestrate dbt from tools like Airflow, Dagster, and Prefect.

    • Use usage data, support trends, and customer conversations to find the biggest sources of pain, size them, and bring that evidence into planning.

 

Skills We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, ideally on developer tools, data infrastructure, or platform products.

  • Experience with workflow orchestration or scheduling systems, as a builder or a heavy user (for example Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, or an in-house scheduler).

  • A strong technical foundation: you can reason about distributed systems, queues, and reliability tradeoffs, and engage deeply with engineers on technical decisions.

  • Hands-on experience with dbt for analytics engineering.

  • A quantitative approach: you enjoy digging into usage and reliability data and connecting it to strategy.

  • A track record of shipping in close partnership with engineering and design, and influencing stakeholders without authority.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, from crisp specs to executive-level narratives.

  • Comfort working asynchronously on a distributed, remote team.

 

Bonus Skills​

  • Experience building observability, alerting, or incident management products.

  • Experience with CI/CD and Git-based workflows (GitHub, GitLab) or infrastructure as code (for example Terraform).

  • Knowledge of modern data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Redshift) and the analytics engineering ecosystem.

  • Experience with Fivetran or other data movement and ELT tools.

  • Hands-on experience using AI agents in your own workflow, and opinions about how they should interact with production systems.

Company Description

Today, when you go to your doctor and get referred to a specialist, your doctor sends out a referral and tells you, “They’ll be in touch soon.” So you wait. And wait. Sometimes days, weeks, or even months. Why? Because too often providers are overwhelmed with the painstakingly tedious work required to get paid by insurance companies. Powered by proprietary models, Tennr handles the complex paperwork that gets patients through the door and providers paid, helping operators get patients the right care, at the right time, in the right setting.

Role Description

As we scale our product surface area, we’re looking for Product Managers who are excited to own a variety of high-impact products, and drive outsized outcomes in hard-to-solve and ambiguous problem spaces. This is a role designed for builders who thrive in ambiguity, love solving complex user and workflow problems, and take full ownership of outcomes - from defining the problem space to shipping, scaling, and driving real customer and business impact.

As a Product Manager, you will be accountable for setting the vision, strategy, and end-to-end execution of one or more core product areas. This is not a “manage the roadmap” role—it’s a “make it successful” role. You’ll develop a deep understanding of users, their day-to-day workflows, and the broader ecosystem they operate in. You’ll identify the highest-leverage problems to solve and turn messy, real-world complexity into simple, scalable experiences. You will hold the standard on quality, and not rest until your product is creating the level of impact in the field that you expect.

You’ll work closely with design, engineering, customer-facing teams, and other product managers. You will lead product discovery, define clear requirements, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and push products from 0→1 and from 1→scale with urgency and clarity. This is a highly cross-functional and user-centered role—ideal for someone who loves building foundational experiences that make complex work feel effortless.

  • Lead product discovery through user interviews, workflow mapping, usability testing, shadowing, and qualitative/quantitative research.

  • Translate ambiguous, messy problems into clear product requirements, user stories, and intuitive experiences.

  • Build, launch, and iterate on new capabilities from 0→1 and from 1→scale, ensuring fast learning cycles and high-quality execution.

This position can be based out of San Francisco or New York.

OVERVIEW

Modern Treasury is hiring a Product Manager to help build and grow our Payments product. Payments enables companies to move money across the world. You will own core capabilities like how businesses get onboarded, verify identity, meet compliance requirements, access payment rails, and manage liquidity over fiat and stablecoin, all through Modern Treasury. You’ll bring products to life using advanced AI tools and leading engineering and customer-facing teams.

As a Product Manager on Payments, you will work with engineering, compliance, partnerships, and customer-facing teams to ship the infrastructure that powers payments for some of the largest and fastest-growing companies in the economy. Modern Treasury is often the most critical piece of infrastructure our customers use, and the Payments product sits at the center of how money actually moves.

We are looking for someone who has built payments products before and is excited to go deep on the full lifecycle of money movement — from a customer's first onboarding moment through real-time payments at scale, across both US and international rails.

ABOUT MODERN TREASURY

Modern Treasury provides trusted infrastructure for money movement. The company helps teams launch and scale payment experiences in days, not months. With best-in-class developer tools and a single API for fiat and stablecoins—plus built-in compliance, ledgering, and reporting—Modern Treasury enables businesses to move money instantly, reliably, and at scale.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Payments Product Manager, you will own products that make up Modern Treasury's Payments offering. You will leverage AI where possible and push the envelope of what AI-enabled product execution looks like. You will be responsible for researching, designing, and delivering products related to:

  • Onboarding & Compliance: You will help manage the experience of getting customers and their end users onto the platform quickly and safely. You will design onboarding flows that reduce time-to-first-payment while meeting the requirements of banks, partners, and regulators. You will also work closely with our compliance and risk teams to translate KYC, KYB, sanctions, and other regulatory requirements into product.

  • Payment rails: You will go deep into the design of the rails that power payments — domestic schemes like ACH, wire, and RTP, international and cross-border rails, and emerging options including stablecoins. You will prioritize which rails to add and how to expose them in a unified, reliable way. You will also work with Customer Success and Support teams to ensure reliability and good support in cases of incidents.

  • Liquidity: You will help define how funds are funded, held, and moved so that customers can settle payments efficiently. You will work on the product capabilities that give customers visibility and control over balances and liquidity across accounts and rails. In this role, you’ll interface with existing bank partners and stablecoin partners, and help scale the Payments across geographies.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • AI Fluency: You will help build and run AI-native workflows across the business. This is a hands-on, business-first role: you will identify inefficiencies, scope solutions, and use the best AI tools available to create compounding leverage for the team. You do not need to train models, but you should be fluent in applying modern AI tools to real business problems.

  • Payments experience: You have built payments products before and are familiar with both US and international payments. You understand how rails work end to end and what it takes to move money reliably at scale.

  • Cross-border expertise: Ideally, you have experience with both US and international cross-border payment rails, and you understand the operational and regulatory realities of moving money across borders.

  • Interest in or experience with stablecoins: You have experience with, or a strong interest in, stablecoins. You’ve studied how they work, and have opinions about how they fit into the future of global money movement.

  • Technical fluency: You relish going deep with engineers on the details of payment systems. You are technical-literate — you can read API docs and bank or scheme specs — and you are comfortable diving into data, including SQL, while knowing when not to.

  • Customer obsession: You want to spend a ton of time with customers and prospects, understanding their business models, flows of funds, and the support they need. You can translate those needs into clear engineering requirements.

  • Ownership at scale: You have a track record of shipping and iterating on products and are comfortable with a dynamic, responsive roadmap driven by the demands of customers and partners. You can work across compliance, partnerships, sales, and customer success to deliver.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Growth
jobs.descriptionHtml:
BitGo (NYSE: BTGO) is the digital asset infrastructure company delivering custody, wallets, staking, trading, financing, stablecoins, and settlement services from regulated cold storage. Since 2013, BitGo has focused on accelerating the transition of the financial system to a digital asset economy. BitGo maintains a global presence and multiple regulated entities, including BitGo Bank & Trust, National Association, the first federally chartered digital asset trust bank owned by a publicly traded company. Today, BitGo serves thousands of institutions, including many of the industry's top brands, financial institutions, exchanges, and platforms, and millions of investors worldwide. For more information, visit www.bitgo.com.

This role requires being full-time onsite at our Toronto office to support collaborative team dynamics and innovative problem-solving. 

BitGo powers millions in daily transactions for 1,500+ institutions and thousands of individuals who need seamless, secure mobile access to their digital assets. We still think it’s early and that the industry needs an all-in-one app that combines security, wallets, trading, staking, payments, and financing into a mobile first experience. This is a rare chance to own and define the product experience for our users at scale. If you’re passionate about building intuitive, high-performance mobile 

About the team

The Growth team at BitGo is responsible for expanding the user experience and feature set at BitGo. There are two main applications that we’re developing at the moment: The first mobile app is hyper optimized to help institutions manage workflows, such as moving billions on-chain, at scale without compromising security.

The second mobile app is focused on making crypto accessible to everyone and broadly applicable in day to day life. This requires unwavering focus on the end to end experience (from onboarding to first on-chain activity) and understanding of crypto’s edge over other mediums (e.g. payments). 

As Senior Product Manager, you will lead a team of engineers and designers to launch our mobile apps, grow usage, and make something users can’t stop raving about. 

What you’ll do

  • Develop retail-first mobile experiences, making buying, selling, staking, lending, and on-chain interactions frictionless.
  • Own and define the end-to-end mobile strategy, ensuring seamless and secure user experiences.
  • Optimize approval workflows for institutions, making transactions fast, intuitive, and hyper-secure.
  • Drive the roadmap and set KPIs for your team and vertical
  • Experiment with different user acquisition strategies to see what works and what doesn’t
  • Work closely with engineering, security, fraud, risk and compliance teams to balance usability with institutional-grade security.
  • Analyze engagement metrics to drive user retention and feature adoption.
  • Partner with Marketing and Growth teams to expand usage and onboard new users.
  • Stay ahead of mobile crypto trends, continuously iterating on the mobile experience.

Responsibilities

  • Define, prioritize, and launch high-impact features that enhance user engagement and security.
  • Partner with engineering, design, security, and compliance teams to ship best-in-class mobile experiences.
  • Ensure feature parity across iOS and Android, optimizing for global adoption.
  • Drive onboarding optimizations, improving activation rates for both institutional and retail users.
  • Establish key mobile performance metrics, ensuring BitGo’s apps set the industry standard for usability and security.
  • Act as the voice of the user, ensuring product decisions are aligned with institutional and retail needs.

Who you are

  • 5+ years of product management experience, preferably in scaling consumer applications to a large number of users.
  • Significant experience in improving growth metrics such as DAUs and Assets under custody.
  • Deep experience in mobile UX/UI, with a strong understanding of secure and frictionless design.
  • Knowledge of crypto wallets, custody, staking, and blockchain transactions is a major plus.
  • Strong analytical mindset—comfortable making data-driven decisions.
  • Proven ability to work cross-functionally, aligning engineering, design, and compliance teams.
  • Ability to execute in a fast-moving, high-growth environment while keeping security at the forefront.

Why Join BitGo?

Disrupting an industry takes vision, innovation, passion, technical chops, drive to deliver, collaboration, and execution. Join a team of great people who strive for excellence and personify our corporate values of ownership, craftsmanship, and open communication. We are looking for new colleagues who bring innovative ways of thinking and problem-solving, and who want risks to be part of the team that changes the world’s financial markets.

Benefits may vary based on location.

Pay Transparency Notice:

Depending upon your leveling and location, the compensation for this role averages between $200,000 and $240,000 CAD base salary. Equity, an annual performance bonus, and the benefits outlined above are also part of this role’s package.

Cryptocurrencies are the most disruptive change the financial services industry has seen in years. Join us and you'll be able to look back and say you were part of the team that transformed investing.
